(68)thego:re21 ske stun sheste /)krung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

mdo sde/ (mi (68)0285 dpang skong phyag brgya pa zhes bya ba/ 3bsdur mchan/(11) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(12)0286 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 13bsdur mchan/(17) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(17)0287 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 18rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de sungs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/

zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba bad de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(33) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(35)0288 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 36bsdur mchan/(46) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(48) 0289 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ gorgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(58) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(59)0290 sangs rgyas bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 60rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā war ma la sogs pa dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(71) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(73)0291 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 74rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha

ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(82) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(870292 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo chos kyi rnam grangs chen po/ 85rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sing ha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(99) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(101)0293 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 102rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /'i len dra bo rnyi dang / pradz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi losmo ba ban de ye shes sdes ṭī ka dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(123) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(125)0294 'phags pa sangs rgyas mi spang ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 126rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(139) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(141)

0295 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 142rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(149) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(150)0296 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 151rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(156) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(157)0297 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ 158bsdur mchan/(160) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)0292 chos rjes su dran pa/ 161bsdur mchan/(162) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(162)0299 dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/ 163bsdur mchan/(167 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(167

0300 bslab pa gsum gyi mdo zhes bya ba/ 165bsdur mchan/(166) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(167)0301 'phags pa sku gsum zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 168bsdur mchan/(171) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(171)0302 'phags pa phung po gsum pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 172bsdur mchan/(218) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(222)0303 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 223bsdur mchan/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(230)0304 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 231rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra pra bha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(237)— 5
ri mchan/(772) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(842)

༄ga /dbang skong phyag brgya pa zhes bya ba/⑨༄༅gi zhadapang skong phyag brgya pa zhes bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa rab 'byam dum lus pa'i dkon mchog thams cad la gus pas duphyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs kyisnyisangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'od 'phro de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar mtshams kyi sangs rgyas ting nge 'dzin gyi glang po dam pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho mtshams kyi sangs rgyas pad mo 68—3

dam pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub mtshams kyi sangs rgyas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dam pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang mtshams kyi sangs rgyas gdugs dam pa'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas pad mo'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma phyogs kyi sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas don yod grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde dga' ba'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas tshe mtha' yas de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+e drur+ya'i sti'od kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sā tshola'i me tog kun tu rgyas pa'i dbang po'i rgyal ①po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin po che'i dpal gyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas ud pa la rgyas pa bsung gi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gyi 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 68—4

snying pos rab tu7'dul ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo bsgragasalgepa'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas rab tu gdon mi za ba pad mo rgyas pa'i sku de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul med pa'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas seng ge de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu snang ba'i 'jig rten na sangs rgyas rin po che'i gtsug phud de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od bzang po'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas chos kyi 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sku de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu bzang po'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i blo gros 'od zer gyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me long gi dkyil 'khor bsgrags pa'i 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas zla ba'i thugs de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pad mo dpal gyi 'jig rten na/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dusangs rgyas zla 'od de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mdzes chen de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gyi dkyil 'khor dbang po'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dga' ba'i spyan de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dpal de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi gzu ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa'i yon tan gyi 'od zer de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas smon lam thams cad las 'byung ⑤ba'i rin po che'i gzi brjid shin tu 68—5

'phags pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas grags pa'i 1sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rdo rje'i rgya mtsho'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor can de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas log par dad sel de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser thub de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od srung de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dpal7rnam par snang mdzad chen po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi sku mu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i sku gzugs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring bsrel thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod rten thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i chos mdo'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyadango pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung du bstan pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ched du brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gleng gegazhi'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa brjod pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes pa rabs kyi sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmad du byung ba'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rtogs pa bstan pa'i sde la phyag 68—6

'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod theg pa chen po'i mdzod thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi gsung rab thams cad dang /'dul ba thabs kyi sgo mo ma lus pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo chos kyi dbyings yang dag pa'i mtha' brjod du med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs te/ dam pa'i chos kyi yi ge thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan med pas byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' rgyal bas byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang shar mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par rgyal bas rnam par gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar lho mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' lag na pad mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho nub mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma rab tu snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub byang mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og gi phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' pad mo dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang 68—7

chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par grags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob patul phyag 'tshal lo /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab chen po'i mchog 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i mchog 'phags pa mod gal7gyi bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mang du thos pa'i mchog 'phags pa kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo//sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi mchog 'phags pa 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bslab pa la gus pa'i mchog 'phags pa nor sbyin 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog 'phags pa nye bar 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan mnga' ba'i mchog 'phags pa ma 'gags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dri zhing lan ldon pa'i mchog 'phags pa rab 'byor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshalasathams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad pas phyag 'tshal nas / /sdig pa kun byang dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /bcom ldan so so'i bka' las ci 'byung ba/ /yon tan khyad par can de grub par shog /phyogs bcu'i dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod cing bsngags so/ /blta zhing brtag go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams rab 'byamakhulas byungakyib mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs mchog /gtso bo/ dam pa/68—8

khyad par can/ bzang po/ gya rnam pa/ bla na med pa/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pas phyogs bcu'i snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad ①byur bur bkang ste/chos kyi mchod pa dang bcas pas ma lus mishelus lus pa med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la phyi ma'i mu'i mthar rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mchod cing 'don to/ /dbul zhing gsol lo/ /bkur ster bgyi'o/ /bla mar bgyi'o/ /ri mor bgyi'o//mnyes par bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gi skye ba 'di dang skye bshethog ma dang bsnyem ma mchis pa nas srid pa gsum gyi 'khor ba na 'khor zhing 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gsum gyi dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga la sogs te/ gsung rab kun las 'gal ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bdag gis ci bgyis pa dang /gzhan la bcol ba dang / gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag rdul tsam bag tsam yang ma lus par mthol zhing bshags so/ /sbyangs shing bsal to①/ /gzhig cing gdon to/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /mi bsnyen mi bgyid do/ /de nas de'i tshe sdig pa thams cad ni byang / bsod nams thams cad ni rdzogs te/ dus 'di nas nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dgongs pa'i dbang gis ched du sprul pa ma gtogs par nam nam zhar zhar tshe tshe rabs rabs su ngan song gsum la sogs te/ bgegs rigs thams cad du mi skye zhing tsomi ltung bar shog shigani /log pa mi dge ba'i las ⑨la mi phyogs mi bgyid 'o )par shog shig⑩ /las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu la mi phyogs mi bsogs tunyepar shog shigatso /smad pa'i lus dang sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu kun las thar nas phyin cad༄mi myong bar shog shig8 /dus 'di nas nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis 68—9

kyi bar du sgo gsum nas dge ba chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du rgyun mi ①'chad par shog shigs /tshe rabs gar skyes kyang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan te/sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba la mthu dang dbang yod par shog shig③ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa 'ba' zhig gi thugs su chud pa'i chos bla na med pa'i byang chub tu gdon mi za bar 'tshang rgya ba'i don de kho na nyid gang yin pa de bdag gis kyang ma nor bar khong du chud cing bsgomasakyil/ gzhan dag la yang0ma nor bar ston cing 'dren par shog shig⑥ /dus 'di nas nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi ste/ bdag nyid lus dbul gyis dume)thugs rje chen po dang7ldan pa rnams kyis so so nas rtag tu bzhes shig /ji ltar na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dngos po phyorathams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched kyis ma zin pa'i chos bdag med pa dang mnyam pa/ thog ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ltar bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi sems ni nam gzhar yang mi stor zhing dge ba'i nyunyebashes gnyen dam pa de dang nam yang mi 'bral bar shog shig /ji ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas de dag bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba ltar/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /nam 'chi bar nges pa'i dus de na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyi72zhal mngon sum du mthong nas/ phyag 68—10

g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can brkyang ste/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas lung nod par gyur cig /bdag gis kyang nyon mongs pas sems mi 'khrul par chos bdag med pa dang 'thun7pa'i 'dun pa can dang / byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa dang ldan bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed par shog shig /mdor na bag chags ma lus kun byang nas/ /bsod nams ye shes 31gas gnyis yongs rdzogs te / /'gro ba ma lus byin gyis bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid myur du mngon par sangs rgyas shog /dpang skong phyag brgya pa rdzogs sonya// // bod du dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i snga ltas su lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring la pho brang yum bu bla mkhar du nam mkha' las babs mi rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 'ong zhes rmi lam du lung bstan te chos kyi dbu brnyes so// //①bsdur mchan/2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ni〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉'byams/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉par/0〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/4 ①〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ḍūr+ya'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sa/ ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 po'i rgyal/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉uta/0〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 tog gi/5 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 rab tu/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgrags/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 pad mo dpal gyi phyag 'tshal lo// 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzu ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gzugs/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉byung /6 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 grags pa'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉dpa' pa'i dpal zer/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dpa'/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉brnyad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bsnyed/ ④〈〈li 〉〉gling /8 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol〉〉 pa/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mo'u 'gal/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mo'u dgal/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉btsal/ ⑤〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉'byams/68—11

༄ga /'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄ho /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a tsin t+ya rā dzakusu tra nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mishekhyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā ⑤na chos kyi dbye dgon 0pa na/ byang chub kyi snying po na seng ge'i khri rdo rje dang nor bu rin po ches spras pa'i pad ma'i snying po'i gdan la bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi rdul phra rab snyed ⑦kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang thabs cig⑧ku bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems — 68—13

dpa' chen po de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 1kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa geyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje rab tu 'joms pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje rab tu 'joms gepa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer shin tu stug po pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer shin tu stug po pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 68—14

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas seng ge'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas seng ge'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi 'od zer me tog rab tu rgyas pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi 'od zer me tog rab tu rgyas pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes 'od zer rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes 'od zer rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bskal pa gcig gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla ba'i blo gros kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dgatu'adi ltar bskal pa bgrang ba'i thabs 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis rtsis gepa'i 'jig rten gyi ④khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rgya mtsho'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa'i tha ma 'jig rten gyi khams pad ma'i dpal zhes bya ba na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 68—15

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba bzang po'i dpal bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis thos par 'gyur gyi/gzhan dag gis ni thos par mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang /lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi ①rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal pos gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa bsam gyis mi⑧khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sel// //ci68—16

༄ga /'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya da sha di ku lasan dha kā ra bi dh+wanashes na nā ma ma hā yā na sru giritra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi nang na/ ser skya'i gnas shing n+ya gro dha'isnyikun dga' ra ba na dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byams pa dang /ri 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor chen po dang thabs cig 3tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro'i dus kyi tshe/ sham thabs gsol nas/ lhung〈kyebazed dang / chos gos bsnams gete/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas ser skya'i gnas kyi gong khyer chen 68—18

por bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /de'i tshe na shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal zhes bya ba zhig bya ba ①'ga' zhig gi phyir shing rta la zhon nas ser skya'i gnas grong khyer chen po nas phyir byung ba dang / shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal gyis/bcom ldan 'das thag ring po kho na nas gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shing rta de las babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasnyenas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi byaspyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di na5snyebadag gi pha ma gnyis gnyid log pa dang ma log pa dag la mi ma lags pa rnams rnam par 'tshe bar bgyid la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang gang gi tshe ljongs kyi phyogs gzhan du mchi ba'i tshe/ bdag la yang 3)chom rkun pa dag rnam par 'tshe bar bgyid cing / gcan gzanasadag kyang rnam par 'tshe bar bgyid na/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du ci nas kyang bdag la mi'am/ mi ma lags pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa 'ga' yang rnam par 'tshe bar mi bgyid pa de ltar bdag la legs par bsrung ba 1skumadzad du gsol/ bsrung ba'i cho ga yang bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la 68—19

zung tsho shig nanodang ngas khyod la ri bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/ shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyad khri 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams nyon mongs pa thams cad bskyod pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de / de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes spyod ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir shar phyogs su 'gro na/ de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te dran par gebyas shing mdun du byas te/ sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing song na khyod la 'jigs pasre'abyung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe ma g.yengs par de yid la byas na khyodakyibya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa che/ /rje la rab tu phyag 'tshal te/ /rtag tu de ni semangon byed cing / /'gro na khyod la 'jigs mi 'byung / /gzhon nu lho phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing dgu khri 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mun pa dang mun nag gi tshogs bcom 95zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sems dang po bskyed pa yid la mdzad pa rnam grangs bsnyengs pa dang bag tsha ba dang bral bas mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so//gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir lho phyogs su 'gro na/ de'i tshe 68—20

khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te dran par byas shing mdun du byas te/ sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing / khyim la sogs pa'i0)yid la byed pa dang bral ba rnam par ma g.yengs pa yid la byed pas song na/ khyod bya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur zhing / khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /khyim gyi bsam pa rnams dang ni/ /kun nas ldang ba kun bral zhing / /lho phyogs su ni 'gro ba na/ /khyod la 'jigs pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gzhon nu nub phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams yul phebs pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khon dang rgyags pa rnam par gnon pa zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugos te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir nub phyogs su 'gro na de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te/ dran par byas shing mdun du byas nas sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing zag pa med pa dngas②/ rnam par ma g.yengs pa dang dran pas7song na khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /chos 'ga' skyes pa yod min zhingasnye/ /'ga' yang 'gag par mi 'gyur te/ /gang gis chos rnams de ltar shes/ /de la 'jigs pa ci yang med/ /gzhon nu byang phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag stong 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa can zhes bya 68—21

ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir byang phyogs su 'gro na/ de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te dran par byas shing mdun du byas te/ sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing rnam par ma g.yengs par yid la byed pas song na/ khyod bya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur zhing khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi0)sems byos la/ /sems can de la ma brnyas nadang / /khyod la 'jigs parang 'byung mi 'gyur / /gzhon nu byang shar gyi phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyad khri 'das pa can 'jig rten gyi khams bdud kyi sde bcom pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcomasasnipa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam rdzi gnon zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par mdzad de/gzhon nu de ni de bzhin gshegs pa de byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa'i skyes bu'i rtsal de lta bu 7byung ba yin no/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir byang shar gyi phyogs su 'gro na de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la 68—22

phyag 'tshal te dran par byas shing mdun du byas tenyu)/ sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing rnam par ma g.yengs du pas song nas khyod bya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur zhing khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /gang gis dang po'i thugs kyis ni/ /bdud rnams pham mdzad sangs rgyas de/ /dran bzhin du ni khyod song na/ /khyod la 'jigs pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gzhon nu shar lho'i phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyi khri 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams rtag tu snang ba zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sems dang po bskyed pas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba'i dpal zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu de bzhin gshegs pa des dang po zugs bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas pa 4nyid kyi bar du bar chad med par sbyin pa byin/ tshul khrims bsrungs/ bzod pa kun tu bsten/ brtson 'grus brtsams/ bsam gtan bsgrubs/ shes rab spyad de/ gzhon nu de ni de bzhin gshegs pa de'i skyes bu'i rtsal de lta bu byung ba yin no/ /gzhin nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir shar lho'i phyogs su 'gro na/ de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal te/ phyis khyim nas song 3shig dang / khyod la phyis 'gyod pa'am 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par ma g.yengs pas yid la byed na/ khyod bya ba gang gipo phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur ro / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal 68—23

tol/ /yan lag lngas ni phyag 'tshal te/ /phyi nas khyim nas song shig dang / /chom rkun rnams kyis khyod kun tu/ /zil gyis mi non 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gzhon nu lho nub kyi phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sum khri 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gdugs 'phags snang zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir lho nub kyi phyogs su 'gro na de'i tshe khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te dran par byas shing mdun du byas te/ sems kyi rgyun gyis de mngon du byed cing rnam par ma g.yengs pa'i yid la byed pas song na ༅khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing khyod bya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /me tog sil mas gtor cig dang / /khyod ni lho nub 'gro ba na/ /'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu nub byang gi phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung drug gegi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams yongs dag rab gnas mngon par 'phags zhes7bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba sazhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni mi gtsang ba med pa/'khrig pa med pa/ bud med med pa/ tsher ma dang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo 68—24

med pa/ snyigs ma lnga med pa yin no/ /gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bya ba 'ga' zhig gi phyir nub byang gi phyogs su 'gro na tshangs par spyod pa yang dag par blangs nas phyis khyim nas rnam par ma g.yengs pa'i yid la byed pas song 3)shig dang /gzhon nu khyod bya ba gang gi phyir 'gro ba'i bya ba de 'grub par 'gyur zhing khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /tshangs spyod yang dag blangs byas te/ /phyi nas khyim nas songasashig dang / /khyod ni gang dang gar 'gro yang / /chom rkun rnams kyis zil mi non/ /gzhon nu steng gi phyogs logs ②su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung drug cu'i dubye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig (3rten gyi khams dmigs pa med pa yid la byed pa can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sanges rgyas skrag med mun bral ting nge 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal po zhes bya ba dal)ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal te dran par byas shing mdun du byas te 'dug kyang rung / 'greng yang rung / sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas shing gnas na khyod la 'jigs pa gang nas kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /khyod kyis ma g.yengs pa/yid byed kyis/ /rtag tu rgyal ba de dran zhing / /rtag tu byams pa'i sems byos dang / /khyod la 'jigs pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gzhon nu 'og gi phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing dgu khri nyis stong 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi 68—25

khams yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang po sems bskyed the tsom 1tshogacod mdzad nyon mongs bskyod ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes so/ /gzhon nu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de la bya ba rtsom pa thams cad dang / 'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / 'chag kyang rung ste / spyod lam thams cad du phyag 'tshol cig /yid la byos shig dang /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems sgrubasakhushig dang ske/ gzhon nu khyod la 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / dgos pa thams cad kyang 'bad mi dgos par 'grub par ge'agyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /bya ba kun la nyin mtshan du/ /sangs rgyas de ni dran bya zhing / /byang chub sems kyang ma gtang cadang / /khyod la 'jigs pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gzhon nu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi mtshan legs par bzung bar gyis shig /legs par bcang bar gyis shig /legs par kun chub par gyis shig dang / 'jigs pa'agono/ bag tsha ba'amanya/spu zing 7zhes byed pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad khyod la 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi mtshan rnams bzung lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la 'jig rten gyi khams de dag mun pa ma mchis shing / bcom ldan 'das bdag 68—26

gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag kyang dper na de bzhin gshegs pa da ltar 'khor rnams la chos ston pa bzhin du mthong ngo / /de nas 'khor de las shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal la sogs pa skye bo phal po che'i ①tshogs bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan⑧pa'i phyir 'khor der 'dus par gyur pa'i srog chags stong tshang ba de dag thams cad stan las langs te③/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ④nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi dudon gyi slad du de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pas bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la phyogs de dge dang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang mun pa ma mchis par gda' la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams de dag dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang dper na/ da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston pa 'di bzhin du gda'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcigapo)tu byas nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de spyilogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mtshan rnams thos nas mig rnam par dag cing phyogs bcu dag na 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag 68—27

mchis pa de dag dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag mthong ba de dag gi mig rnam par dag pa'i bsod nams de dag bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshe rabs gzhan 1)du tshe 'phos na yang 'bral bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te mi 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag 'di ltar mig rnam par dag pa de dag ni sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis shin tu rnam par dag pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu khyod kyis srog chags stong tshang ba 'di mthong ngam / shā ri'i bu 'di dag thams cad ni sangs rgyas rnams5gekyi mtshan bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis re res kyang 'khor los sgyural ba'i rgyal srid gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed〈gedag byed du bcug nas srid pa tha ma dang / lus tha ma la byang chub kyi tshogs thams cad rdzogs par byas te/ bskal pa gcig la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan dag pas brgyan pa zhes bya bar mtshan 'thunangasapa sha stag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu de rnams lung bstan pa bshad pa 'di bka' stsal ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te/ 'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/ g.yos rab tu g.yos / kun tu rab tu g.yos/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'urazhu/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur sdu/ ldegasherab tu ldeg6) /kun tu rab tu ldeganyurte /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem/ 'khrugs rab tu 'khrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs so/ /sa bla'i lha hornams kyis kyang kye ma grogs po dag 'di ltar 68—28

rigs kyi bu 'di rnams kyis ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su bzung zhing chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pas don thams cad thugs su chud pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba ni ngo mtshar che ste/ su zhig sangs rgyas la dad par mi 'gyur zhes sgra bsgrags so/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / sum cu5)rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab7bral bsnyernams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud kyisaris rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams nas 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar gyis sa bla'i lha rnams kyis ༅sgra de thos nas yi ⑦rangs shing rab tu dga' la dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas tshig 'di skad ces kye ma grogs po dag 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'di rnams kyiso de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs su bzung zhing chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pas don thams cad thugs su chud pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba ni ngo mtshar che ste/ su zhig sangs rgyas la dad par mi 'gyur zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 'dzin par byed/ 'chang bar byed/ klog par byed / kun chub par byed cing / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu0ston par byed pa dang / tha na glegs bam la bris te 'chang bar byed na/68wa 29

rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang /sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /de dag la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /de dag gshis mingan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag pha rol gyi rimiganod pas 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de dag la chu dang / chom rkun dang / dug dang / mtshon gyis 'jigs pa mi 'byung bar yid ches par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bsrung ba lung bstan pa 'di lta bu 'di shes nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung ba'i phyir lha'i bu stong tshang bas ④yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ④ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang srog chags stong tshang ba gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyis ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa de dag la lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i me tog man dā gyur ra ba dang / man dā skyer ba chen po rnams kyis mngon par gtor ri nas thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig matu 'dug nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi rnam (grangs 'di 'dzin par bgyid pa dang /'chang bar bgyid pa dang / klog par bgyid pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa de dag bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag khyim na nyu )mchis sam/ dgon pa na mchis sam/ shing drung na mchis sam / khyim stong pa na mchis sam/ 'brog dgon pa na mchis sam lam 68—30

dang lam gol ba na mchis sam/ gnyid log gam gnyid ma log pa dag na yang de dag la pha rol gyi gnod pas 'gum par mi 'gyur bar bdag gis bsrung bar bgyi'o / /de nas bcom ldan tsho14)'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang /gnas mal dang / snyun gyi gsos sman dang /zho yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byed na/ kun dga' bo de tsam gyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur sti byas par mi 'gyur/ bla mar byas par mi 'gyur/ ri mor byas par mi 'gyur/mchod pa gebyas par mi 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 'dzin par byed dam/ — 'chang bar byed dam/ klog par byed dam/kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang casadag par rab tu ston tam/ tha na glegs bam la bris te 'chang na/ kun dga' bo de tsam gyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur ste gedam pa dang / bla mar bya ba dam pa dang /ri mor bya ba 6dam pa dang / mchod pa dam pas bkur sti byas pa yinan/ bla mar byas pa yin/ ri mor byas pa yin/ mchod pa byas pa yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig natu byas nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar 68—31

gzung bar bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun0)dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya bar zung ri shig /'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba dang / dngos po med par rtogs pa zhes bya ba dang / mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa zhes bya bar yang zung geshig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / shākya gzhon nu bzhin rab gsal dang / srog chags stong tshang ba de dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi skyirangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs soge// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/ zhu rtsichen gyi lots+tsha rtsob ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhusachen bgyis te gtan la phab pa// //68—32

bsdur 'bras re'u migamado / (177)

༄ga /'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sap+ta bud dha ka na nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ti se'i ri'i rtse mo lha'i gnas na drang srong gi spyod pa dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang / kun tu bzang po dang / mtha' yas me tog dang / kun nas me tog dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa sha stag dang thabs cig ci tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ri'i rtse mo'i nags khrod 68—36 nga

de nyid na dge slong zhig 'byung pos zin nas brdol cing gcer bu gos med la lag pa bsgreng ste ngu zhing 'dug pa gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dkyil na kyi hud ces sgra 'byin pa 'di dang /dge slong gcer bu gos ma mchis pa/ lag pa stong7pa cigasashos 'di yangasasu zhig lags/ de nas bcom7ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'di ni nad kyis btab pa yin no/ /cigatswashos 'di yang nad kyis btab pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying tres 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i rig sngags bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas sprul pa mdzad de/ de nas nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa drug byung ngo / /bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'o/ /de nasashede bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bu ⑧ya/ na mo dharmā ya/na maḥsi rtswa 'kho/ tabya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ hi li hi li ya/ na mo dza /⑩ /68—37

na ma :nā ya/ na mo na maḥchag hā/ de nas mide bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig rig sngags 'di 'chang ngams/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ chu dang / sdug bsngal ba'i nad kyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de dug zos kyang zas bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /zas dang skom la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te zos na pha rol gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /nad thams cad kyis btab par mi 'gyur ro/ /ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshon btab pa'i rna bar grubabazlas brjod byas la sna rigema'i mar sbyin no/ /mdze dang spangs nad kyis btab pa rnams la sna ma'i mar dang / ud pa la sngon po dang ske/ shu ti dang / nye'u shing rnams bsres pa'i mar byin na nad thams cad sos par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang ske/ 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsi bhā ya/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa pā tsa ya pā tsa rini ya sarba bhū tā shā ni/ sbyin 3)snya ya tī la yas)pa ra bit+yā tshes swā hā / nam mkha'i snying po sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / bsgom nyes pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa 68—38

thams cad bzlog pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dgag pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas gsungs shing / ngas kyang da0)ltar bshad pa'i snying po 'di zung shigazhu /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig nga'ishesnying po 'di nyin lan gsum yid la byed na/ de la pha rol gyi gnod pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mthong bar 'gyur mos/ /gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur zhing mnyes par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'di'i cho ga gzhan ni nad thams cad la skud pas bcing bar bya'o/ /'dus pa las gyur pa la ni sna ma'i mar la bzlas brjod byas te sbyin no/ /chus phyogs bcing bar bya'o/ /skud pas bdag la bsrung ngo / /byis pa rnams kyi gdon gedag la skud pa sngon po7gdags so/ /mtshon btab pa'i rna bar ⑦lan bdun bzlase brjod bya'o/ /gzhan dag la yang rang gi blos sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/na maḥsi bhā ya/ oṃ ma dul ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ku lapo ud sā dha rmā ku ru/ sarba gra hā shā 375 hā/ nam mkha'i snying po gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni bskal pa bzang po'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyis gsungs shing/ ngas hu kyang da ltar bshad pa ste/ nam mkha'i snying po khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag zung hurte68—39

shig /gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na/ de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ dug gis mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi zhenags/rims nad kyis mi 'debs shing chu dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang /gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa ni ma gtogs so/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyenatum gang la la zhig nang par langs nas mgo bkrus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na de'i las kyi sgrib ②pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro//de la sems can sdang ba gang dag dang / rgyal po rnams thog mar smra bar 'gyur rol/ /sems can thams cad de'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa thams cad kyi nang du yid la bya'o/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa thams cad la skud pa dkar po gdags so/ /mig nad la shing 'o ma can las skud pa byas te rna ba la dugadags so/ /dmag rengs par byed par 'dod pas zho dang sbrang rtsi la sbags pa'i 'bras yos la lan brgyasartsa brgyad sbyin sreg 65bya'o/ /rā dza 45rwarā dza mā tremachogebā ba shī ka ro tu0)kā me na⑩/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi sbar shing gis me bus la bsreg bya til dag nyu1lan stong sbyin sreg gebya'o//bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / sdig pa byang7zhing ske/ dpal chen po dang / nor gyi phung po chen po sgrubalgepar 'dod na/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi sbar shing gis me bus la bsreg bya til dag lan stong sbyin sreg bya'o / /sdig pa ji snyed pa thams cad sbyang bar 'dod pa dang / rig sngags thams cad grub ⑩par 'dod pa dang / bdag bkru bar 'dod pas/ shu ti dang ske/ na la da /tsho modang / khre dang / shi ri sha dang / rgya spos dang / gur 68wa 40

gumanyedang / gla sgang dang / yin dra ba ru nashedang / byang chub kyi shing dang /a mra'i mgo lcogs dang / 'di rnams kyis bkru bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar nyin zhag gcig sgyungashebar bya zhing bum pa sar pa bzhag ste/ zla ba nya ba la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi7spyan sngar snying po lan stong rtsa brgyad sngags〈pel khrus bya'o/ /dug mi gdug par byed par 'dod pas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar seng ldeng7gi thur ma ba'i lci bar sgyugs pa brgya rtsa brgyad ming nas smos te sbyin sreg⑧byas na7dug mi gdug par 'gyur ro/ /gdon bsrung ba dang / 'byung po la sogs pa'i las thams cad la yang sbyar bar byas na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa log par dad sel steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi57'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā yal/ na motshosi ghā ya/ na maḥkra ku ts+tshan dā ya/ 17shā ga tā ya/ ar ha te saṃ myaka so bud dhā ya/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/8 kyi ṭi ki ṭi/ ki khri ki khri7/ ki tā pa ya na mcho8swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas log par dad sel ces bya ba gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs shing rjes su yi rangs pa'i〈nyesnying po 'di khyod kyis zung57shig /blangs shing bzung ste kun chub par byas na phyi ma'i tshe dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dag de'i tshe dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rnyed du ste nas khrus byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dag gis mchod pa byas nas 68—41

gsang sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod par gyur na/ tshe rabs bdun du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams kyi nang du lha'i che ba nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang mi rnams kyi nang du 'khor los sgyuratuba'i rgyal por 'gyur〈ro/ /yang na cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs me na de mir skye ba tha ma thob par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur teX/ tshe 'di la yang rtag tu brjod na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zas dang skom gyi rnam pa la lan bdun bsngags te/zos 'thungs na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste skom zhi bar 'dod na bza' ba thams cad la lan stong rtsa brgyad kyis bkru bar bya'o/ /lhog rgal gcod na zangs khab kyis bya'o/ /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'ching ba thams cad las thar bar bya na lan bdun bzlas brjod bya ste/ rtag tu nor yang 'phel bar 'gyur/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'dod na des phyogs gtsang mar mchod rten gyi 'khor sar 6)dkyil 'khor bskus la/ a ga rus bdugs te/ lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na/ de'i drung du sngas shar phyogs su bstan te nyal na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yid la ci smon pa de 57༄thams cad ston to/ /tshe'am stobs sam pham rgyal thams cad kyang ston to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥso 68—42

bhā ya/ na maḥhu)ka na ka mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakar so bud dhā ya / tabya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri si ri si ri/ sī rā 9ya/dha ma dha ma dha ma dha mkha/ dhu ma dhu ma dhu ma dhu ma/ dhu māmadu5)ya/ na mo na maḥ6)ka na ka mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya arta te saṃ myaka776 bud dhā ya swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyis byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig snying po 'di 'dzin cing rtag tu bzlas brjod byed pa de la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung/me dang / chu dang / lce 'bab pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ dug thams cad kyang zas7dang 'dra bar thub par 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ gshis〈)ngan du 'chi bar mi 'gyur0/tshe ring bar 'gyur/ longs spyod che bar 'gyur/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabarwa1par 'gyur motshoske/ /dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas na/ sngon gyi las kyi sgrib par gyur pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /ci ste pha rol nad las thar bar byed pararwarte'adod na ci nus su gtor ma gtong zhing pog gam/ a ga ru'i bdugapha pas bdugs la gza' thams cad la khrus bya'o/ /mdze dang spangs nad dang mchin skran la shu dag 'jam po btags pa sbrang rtsi dang bsres te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngagasaphyogete bskus na mdze nad thams cad sos par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bzhi pa la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sna ma'i me tog gi phreng ba la lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags te/ mi'i mgo la bcings na zhag bzhi7pa'i rims sos par 'gyur ro/ /mtshon btab pa'i rna 68—43

bar bzlas brjod byas na brjed7)byed las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lus srul pos zin pa rnams la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog gis bdug go/ /de la sogs pa'i las rnams byed de/ las thams cad byed pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmākhuya/ na maḥsosabhā ya/ oṃ ha ra ha ra ha radu/ha ha ha/ na maḥkā sh+ya pā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te saṃ myakasnyerma bud ṅgāl)ya/sidhan tu 57man tra pa deḥ40swā hā/ de nas7)de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po snying po 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed dag gis gsungs pa ste/ nam mkha'i snying po snying po 'di khyod kyis zung huḥshig /kun chub par gyis shig /gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ nyin mo'am / mtshan mo lan gsum gsum bzlas rjodal)byed na mdor na mi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur te/ sngon gyi las ni ma gtogs so/ /las thams cad la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /mdze dang sha bkral la sogs pa la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog la sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar lan stong rtsa brgyad bsngags7te bklags〈nyeshing bkrus na sos par 'gyur ro/ /klad pa na ba la sangs rgyas la phul ba'i me tog sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar lan stong rtsa brgyad 68—44

bzlas brjod bya'o/ /thams cad du yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs te/sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don gyi phyir rig sngags 'di dag bka' stsal to / /na mo bud dh+wa lho/ na mo dharmākhuya/ na maḥ shes ya/ tabya thā/ ghu me ghu me ma hā ghu me/ ta le7ta le ma hā ta le/ tsa le tsa le ma hā tsa le/ dhu re dhu re ma hā dhu re/ ti ri ti rishem hā ti risnyi/ ki li ki li ma hā ki li/ tsu ru tsu ru ma hā tsu ru/ mi li mi li ma hā mi li/ ti li ti li ma hā ti li/ dhu me dhu me ma hā dhu me/ tsa le tsa le ma hā tsa le/ khi ri khi ri ma hā khi ri/ tsi li tsi li ma hā tsi li swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ / nam mkha'i snying po klad7pa'i nad bsal na mtshon dang lag mthil gyis bya'o/ /sprin bzlog na shing ka ra bīḍūra'i lhug mas bya'o/ /dug spo na chus bya'o/ /las gzhan rnams kyang bya'o/ /khrus kyi cho gas5)sbyar bar bya'o/ /cho ga thams cad kyis dus thams cad du sbyar bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsalacanas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po yi〈nyerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sonya// //68—45

༄ga /'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/hu) 4lhun /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ②aṣ+ṭa ①bud dha rka ④na ma ma hā yā na sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig ⑤tu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po bya ba byas pa/byed pa byas pa/ khur ⑥bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par 68wa 49

grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag ste/gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'khor de ②nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas de'i mod la stong gsum gyi stong chenakepo'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang gernam pa drug tu g.yos/ ma dkrol rtsotshobar bar snang las sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi sgra dag kyang byung / lha'i me tog man dā'ad/ra ba dang / man 'olor ba 7chen po dang / man dzu sha ka sedang / man dzu sha ka lachen po'i me tog gi char yang bab ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba thams cad rin po che'i me tog gi 7chal pas 11gang bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i mod la thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gser gyi kha dog gi skusnang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de'i 1 rimod la shar phyogs nas pad ma sdong po ni gser/ 'dab ma ni dngul/ze'u choge'abru ni be+e drur+yam/ snying po ni rdo'i snying po las grub pa brgyad cig byung bar gyur to/ /pad ma'i snying po thams cad kyi steng na seng ge'i7khri gru bzhi pa/rtsa ba bzhi zug pa/ bkra ba/ blta 1 na sdug pa/ dri dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ dar gyi lda ldi spyangs 1 pa/ pog poraspyotenas sposa'i )kyi dris shin tu bdugs 1pa/ rin po che sna tshogs du ma dag gis legs par brgyan pa/ dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba du ma 'khrol ba/ rin po che du ma'i bla re ( rtebres pa dag byung bar gyur to/ /seng ge'i khri thams cad kyi steng na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dag kyang bzhugs par yang snang ste/ mdzes pa/ blta (chen sdug pa/ dbang po zhi ba / thugs zhi ba/ dul ba dang zhi gnas mchog brnyes pa/ dul ba dang zhi 68—50

gnas dam pa brnyes pa/ dbang po bsrungs7shing thul ba/ glang po shin tu dul ba ltasabu/ mtsho ltar dngas shingasarnyog pa med la gsal ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cukhutsa gnyis po de dag gis sku legs par brgyan pa/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i skus nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzi brjid zil gyis mnan te bzhugs pa/ spyod lam brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa/ sku mdog bltasnyibs chog mi shes pa dag snang ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shar phyogs nas pad ma sdong po ni gser/ 'dab ma ni dngul/ ze'u 'bru ni bai drur+yaX/ snying po ni rdo'i snying po las grub pa brgyad po 'di dag byung bar gyur te/pad ma'i snying po thams cad kyi steng na seng ge'i khri gru bzhi pa/ rtsa ba bzhi zug pa / bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ dri dang ldan pa/ yid du mchi ba/ dar gyi lda ldi spyangs pa/ pog por〈gunas spos kyi dris shin tu bdugasapo)pa/ rin po che sna tshogs du mas legs par brgyan pa/ dril bu g.yer ku'i 7dra ba du ma 'khrol ba/ rin po che du ma'i bla re bres pa7nyadag byung bar 32gyur pa/ seng ge'i khri thams cad kyi steng na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dag bzhugs par yang gda' ste/ mdzes pa/ bltarwarten sdug pa/ dbang po zhi ba/ thugs zhi ba/dul ba dang zhi gnas mchog brnyes pa/ dul ba dang zhi gnas dam pa brnyes pa/dbang po bsrungs shing thul ba/ glang po che shin tu dul ba lta bu/ mtsho ltar dngas shing rnyog pa med la gsal ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa 68—51

gnyis po dag gis sku legs par brgyan pa/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i skus nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzi brjid zil gyis mnan te0bzhugs pa/ spyod lam brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa/ sku mdog blta bas chog mi shes pa dag gda' ba'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon55)la yid la zung shigatshwakyedang bshad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gcig gi bye rtenam snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan 5gyis mi thub yipa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu yongs (7bsgrags dpal zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes bral chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed tshe'adas pa na 'jig rten gyi khams yid 'ong dga' zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gsum gyi bye ma snyed tsho/ )'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams sdug dga' zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu 68—52

rnam par gnon pa grags mchog dpal zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung bzhi'i bye ma snyed7)'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams sgo kun nas 'jug pa zhes bya ba yod de②/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsal zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung lnga'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams rnam dag brtsegs ②pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan bkod pa'i dpal kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung drug gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams 'gyur med ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi rgyal po dpal thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung bdun gyi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams spobs pa brtsegs pa gang ba (5)zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che'i pad ma las rnam par gnon pas bzhud pa zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi 68—53

zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung brgyad kyi bye ma snyed 'das pa 37na 'jig rten gyi khams sgra dbyangs snyan pa zhes bya ba yod de / de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che'i pad ma la rab tu gnas pa sā (gela'i rgyal po zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag ni yongs su dag pa ste/ snyigs ma lnga med do/ /ya mtshan can thams cad med do/ /gseg ma dang gyo mo dag med do / /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa med do/ /bud med med do/ /dud 'gro dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten yang med do/ /sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / sdig sbrul gyis reg pa rnams med do/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mtshan nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang ske/ 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang ske/ kun chub par byed pa de dag ngan song gsum du 'gro ba de ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med deri ri/ shā ri'i bu de dag sems can dmyal ba'am/dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba de ni gnas med de tsho / mtshams med pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba'i gang zag ni ma gtogs te/ de yang chung ngu myong zhing mang du myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mtshan nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang / kun chub par byed pa zhu)de byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du nam yang mngon par shes pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ nam 68wa 54

yang mtshan dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ nam yang gzungs dang bral bar mi 'gyur/nam yang dbang po ma tshang bar mi 'gyur/ nam yang sgra dbyangs shin tu rgyas pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ nam yang rnga sgra'i dbyangs dang bral bar mi 'gyur/nam yang sbyin gnas dang phyir mi ldog pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ nam yang byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ nam yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de①/ shā ri'i bu bud med gang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mtshan nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / ston pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang / kun chub par byed pa de bud med kyi dngos po lan gnyis thob par 'gyur ba de ni gnas med do/ /smon lam gyi dbang gis len pa ni ma gtogasasheso/ /shā ri'i bu gnas ma yin zhing ②go skabs med de/ shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mtshan nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / ston pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang /kun chub par byed na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de rgyal pos 'jigs par 'gyur ba'am/ rkun pos sam/ mes bsam/ chus sam/ ma rungs pas sam / klus sam/ gnod sbyin gyis sam/ dri zas sam/ lha ma yin gyis sam/mis sam/ mi ma yin pas 'jigs par 'gyur ba'am/ gang gis kyang 37glags rnyed par 'gyur ba de ni gnas med do/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa drag po ni ma gtogs te/ de yang chung ngu myong zhing mang du myong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don gang ci rtsom yang rung ste/68—55

de dge ba'i chos rnams 'phel ba nyid du 'gyur gyi/ 'grib par mi 'gyur bar re bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'jig rten mgon po de dag gi/ /mtshan rnams 'dzin par byed pa ni/ /mi khom thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /myur du bzang 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes byas nas/ /ston pa de mthong dad byed cing / /'jig rten sgron ma mthong nas kyang / /mchod pa bzang po byed par 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /'khor ba rnam par spong bar byed/ /gang gis 'dren rnams mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /dri med mig kyang rnam par sbyong / /'jig rten mgon po de dag gi/ /mtshan rnams su zhig 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni nyu)gang dang gar skyes par/ /'jig rten phyag bya'i 'os su 'gyur/ / de yi〈gzugs mtshan phun sum tshogs/ /phyug po'i khyim du skye bar 'gyur/ /dpa' zhing sbyin pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /ser sna med cing lhug par gtong / /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por ni / / lha yi5ba tsan dan dmar po yi/ /dri ngad kha nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /drang srong chen po de dag gi/ /mtshan rnams bud med thos gyur na/ /bud med dngos po rnama'agespangs te/ /skyes bu mkhas par red par 'gyur/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /pha dang ma dang spun rnams dang / /mdza' bshes nye du'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal nam yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de dang de dag 'jig rten na/ /'dabakyim stong phrag bye ldan pa'i/ /rin chen pad mar skye bar 'gyur/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad du/ /nam mkha' 68—56

las ni 'gro byed cing / /'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas zhing / /rnam par dag pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon po'i drung dag tu/ /zab mo'i chos ni nyan byed cing / /ji ltar thos pa chud mi gson/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de dag la ni sdig can bdud/ /nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas pas/ /nam yang glags rnyed mi 'gyur ro/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su 'dzin pa/ /de dag mtshon gyis mi gsod0)cing / /dug dang mes kyang ma yin la / /rgyal po dang ni rkun po yis/ /de dag gtse bar byed mi 'gyur/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lto 'phye che rnams kyis/ /glags〈7kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas 'di dag mi mchog ste/ /dpal gyi snying po 'brug gi rgyal/ /mdzangasam pa bag yod gyur nas ni/ /mkhas mi su zhig mtshan mi 'dzin/ /'jig rten mgon po thams cad kyi/ /mtshan rnams 'di dag su nyan pa/ /mi de dag ni cho gas nyen/ /grags ldan rnams kyi mtshan thos nas/ /de dag dpa'akhuzhing shes rab che/ /'jig rten mi mchog sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang ske/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang /lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yikerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa lamathamangon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen 3po'i mdo rdzogs so'i// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa// //sh+lau ka dgu bcu rtsa gcig/ //768—57
